    "/Users/himanshu/Git/aegis/.env",

def keys(path):

    names = []
    for line in p.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
        s = line.strip()
        if not s or s.startswith("#") or "=" not in s:

        name = s.split("=", 1)[0].strip()

# boxes.dev agent-init manifest
#
# This file is the working plan for setting this project up on a
# boxes.dev Template box. A coding agent fills it in with the user's
# guidance; the user can read and edit it directly at any time.
# `dvb agent-init check` validates it; `dvb agent-init run` executes
# it. Secret VALUES never belong in this file - reference files and
# variable names only.
#
# Sections marked TODO(agent) still need a user choice. Replace the
# marker comment with the confirmed choice. `dvb agent-init guide <section>`
# explains each section and how to investigate it.

version: 3

project:
  root: "/Users/himanshu/.paradev/worktrees/aegis/coconut-slider-7d18ab04"
  # Single repository. This folder is a linked worktree of himanshu-nakrani/aegis.
  # Main checkout: /Users/himanshu/Git/aegis (branch main). Env files here match that checkout.
  repositories: ["."]
  rootEntries: []
  name: "aegis" # was the worktree slug coconut-slider-7d18ab04; confirm before launch
#
# TODO(agent): present every current instance type below to the user,
# ask which one they want for this project, record that key here, and
# remove this marker. The choice applies to the Template box and all
# devboxes and cannot be changed after initialization.
# Team default: 4vcpu8gb
# Recommendation: 4vcpu8gb (1.0 box-hour per awake hour). One agent plus
# FastAPI and Next.js. Postgres is optional; SQLite is the copied config.
# Current instance types:
#   4vcpu8gb: 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 100 GB disk (team default, ~1.0 box-hour/hour)
#   4vcpu16gb: 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, 100 GB disk (~1.39 box-hours/hour)
#   8vcpu16gb: 8 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, 100 GB disk (~2 box-hours/hour)
#   8vcpu24gb: 8 vCPU, 24 GB RAM, 100 GB disk (~2.39 box-hours/hour)
#   8vcpu32gb: 8 vCPU, 32 GB RAM, 100 GB disk (~2.78 box-hours/hour)
  instanceType: "4vcpu8gb"

# Codex is connected on boxes.dev. Add claude here if the user connects it.
agents:
  runtime: [codex]
  # Current session is Cursor Grok 4.7, not a Codex or Claude model id.
  setup: null

# Untracked env/secret files the Template box needs for local development.
files:
  env:
    - path: .env
      note: Backend local env from this worktree. Same bytes as the main checkout. SQLite DATABASE_URL.
      vars:
        - { name: GOOGLE_API_KEY, secret: true }
        - { name: DATABASE_URL, secret: false }
        - { name: EXA_API_KEY, secret: true }
        - { name: GEMINI_MODEL, secret: false }
        - { name: CORS_ORIGINS, secret: false }
    - path: frontend/.env.local
      note: Next.js public API origin. Same bytes as the main checkout.
      vars:
        - { name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, secret: false }
  other: []

# External tools/services this project depends on for local dev, and
# config files that live outside the project folder.
external:
  dependencies:
    - name: Python
      version: "3.12"
      evidence: README prerequisites, CI python-version 3.12, local backend/.venv 3.12.13
    - name: Node.js
      version: "20+"
      evidence: README prerequisites; CI uses Node 20. Template baseline already has Node 22.
    - name: Docker
      version: null
      evidence: README and docker-compose.yml. Optional; copied .env uses SQLite, not the compose Postgres.
  configs: []

# No fixtures or slow local assets. .venv, node_modules, and backend/.code-runtime
# are rebuildable (pip, npm ci, python -m app.services.code_runtime --fetch).
artifacts: []

# DATABASE_URL is sqlite:///./aegis.db. No sqlite file is present. Postgres in
# docker-compose is optional and is not the active local database.
databases: []

# How the app runs locally: dev-server commands and background
# services (docker compose services, workers, emulators).
app:
  entrypoints:
    - command: cd backend && . .venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
      description: FastAPI on http://127.0.0.1:8000. Health check GET /health.
    - command: cd frontend && npm run dev
      description: Next.js on http://localhost:3000
  services: []

# Copy uncommitted local changes (dirty worktree) to the Template box?
# TODO(agent): ask for one starting branch for Template setup and new
# devboxes, recommending the remote default (guide: flow). Review local
# work with untracked files below (guide: untracked); included work will
# be saved separately before setup. Record the choices in setupNotes,
# align lifecycle/maintenance branches, then remove this marker.
# Keep the local checkout intact; branch preparation happens remotely.
# copyDirty does not choose a branch or exclude local-only commits.
# No staged or unstaged edits to tracked files. Recommendation: start on main.
localChanges:
  copyDirty: false

# One untracked file: .superset/.ports (10B), Paradev local port state.
untracked:
  copy: true
  mode: custom
  base: defaults
  exclude: [".superset/**"]

# GitHub push/pull access for the Template box and future devboxes.
# managed: use the connected GitHub account automatically
githubAccess: managed
# No private GitHub dependencies in requirements.txt or the frontend lockfile.
githubDependencies: []

# SSH access from the Template box to each repo's origin.
# Kept in skip mode because githubAccess is managed.
# TODO(agent): confirm managed GitHub vs SSH with the user (guide: git-ssh).
gitSsh:
  repos:
    - path: "." # origin: https://github.com/himanshu-nakrani/aegis.git
      mode: skip
      convertOriginToSsh: false

# Git commit signing on the Template box: create (new key), copy (bring the
# local signing key), or skip.
# TODO(agent): ask the user if they sign commits (guide: git-signing).
# Local commit.gpgsign and user.signingkey are unset. Recommendation: skip.
gitSigning:
  mode: skip

# Local Claude/Codex configuration to copy to the Template box (MCP servers,
# skills, settings, memory). Detected items below; remove ids the user
# does not want copied. `dvb agent-init detect agent-config` reprints.
agentConfig:
  include:
    - "claude:memory:CLAUDE.md" # claude/memory_file: CLAUDE.md (9.0KB)
    - "claude:settings" # claude/settings: Claude settings (82.3KB)
    - "claude:skills" # claude/skill: All Claude skills (4.3MB)
    - "claude:commands" # claude/command: Claude commands (10.2KB)
    - "claude:mcp:user:deepwiki" # claude/mcp_server: deepwiki
    - "claude:mcp:user:treg" # claude/mcp_server: treg
    - "codex:memory:AGENTS.md" # codex/memory_file: AGENTS.md (8.8KB)
    - "codex:skills" # codex/skill: All Codex skills (351.0KB)
    - "codex:settings" # codex/settings: Codex settings (12.9KB)
    - "codex:mcp:treg" # codex/mcp_server: treg
    - "codex:mcp:deepwiki" # codex/mcp_server: deepwiki
  # Left out on purpose:
  #   claude:hooks — commands may depend on this computer and can block Claude
  #   claude:permissions — ask the user; not included
  #   command-based and machine-local MCP servers (aws-mcp, browseros-neo, node_repl, …)
  #   codex node_repl credential files (~212MB and ~116MB)

# Import local agent conversation history to the Template box.
# Found 4 local thread(s) for this project and 98 in other folders.
# TODO(agent): ask the user about importing threads (guide: agent-config).
# Recommendation: none now. `dvb threads import` can import later.
agentThreads:
  import: none

# Lifecycle commands run for every devbox created from this Template box.
# git clean -fd keeps ignored files (.env, .venv, node_modules).
devboxLifecycle:
  startupTimeoutSeconds: 120
  startupScript: |
    # Get latest from remote
    git fetch origin

    # Force local main to match origin/main
    git checkout -f -B main origin/main

    # Delete untracked files and folders (ignored deps and env files stay)
    git clean -fd
  teardownTimeoutSeconds: 30
  teardownScript: ""

# Refreshes the Template snapshot when Python or frontend deps change.
templateMaintenance:
  timeoutSeconds: 480
  script: |
    branch=main
    if [ "$(git branch --show-current)" != "$branch" ]; then
      echo "The Template box is not on $branch." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]; then
      echo "The Template box has uncommitted changes." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    git fetch origin "$branch"
    git merge --ff-only "origin/$branch"
    if ! command -v python3.12 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "python3.12 is not installed." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    cd backend
    python3.12 -m venv .venv
    . .venv/bin/activate
    pip install -r requirements.txt
    python -m app.services.code_runtime --fetch
    cd ../frontend
    if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
      npm ci
    else
      echo "frontend/package-lock.json is missing." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  watches:
    - repository: "."
      enabled: true
      paths:
        - backend/requirements.txt
        - frontend/package-lock.json
        - frontend/package.json

# Free-form guidance for the remote setup agent that finishes setup
# on the Template box (install steps, gotchas, verification commands).
setupNotes: |
  Single repository: https://github.com/himanshu-nakrani/aegis.git
  This upload is the linked worktree at
  /Users/himanshu/.paradev/worktrees/aegis/coconut-slider-7d18ab04.
  The main checkout is /Users/himanshu/Git/aegis. The worktree .env and
  frontend/.env.local match that checkout byte for byte, so use the copies
  in this worktree. Do not print secret values.

  Starting branch for Template setup and new devboxes: main (origin/HEAD).
  Current local branch is fix/code-node-wasi-isolation at ea53d54, already
  tracking origin. There are no staged or unstaged edits to tracked files.
  Do not create a stash. Keep the feature branch available in the uploaded
  history; do not check it out for setup. Exclude .superset/.ports.

  Keep .env and frontend/.env.local available while installing. DATABASE_URL
  points at a local SQLite file (sqlite:///./aegis.db). That file is not in
  the worktree yet; the app creates it. Do not dump or start Postgres unless
  the user switches to the compose database.

  Install, without editing tracked files:
  - Python 3.12 outside the repo (the Template image has Node 22, not Python).
    The local venv was created with uv.
  - From backend/: python3.12 -m venv .venv, activate, pip install -r
    requirements.txt, python -m app.services.code_runtime --fetch,
    alembic upgrade head.
  - From frontend/: npm ci. CI uses Node 20; Node 22 on the image is fine.
  - Docker and `docker compose up -d postgres` only if the user wants the
    optional pgvector Postgres. The copied env does not use it.

  Verify: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8000/health should report status ok and
  database_ok true, and `cd frontend && npm run dev` should serve
  http://localhost:3000. If a test or build fails, record the failure.
  Do not change tracked project files.

  GitHub access is managed HTTPS. There are no private GitHub dependencies.
  Commit signing is skipped. Codex is the runtime agent.

content.text:
Sleep pauses the **aegis** box and keeps its files. Wake brings that same box back. Your box is running right now.

In the boxes.dev Mac app, open the status pill in the title bar. Choose **Sleep** while it is running, and **Wake** while it is sleeping. Auto-wake is on, so opening the box or sending a message also wakes it.

From a terminal:

```bash
dvb sleep aegis
dvb wake aegis
```

A sleeping box does not use box-hours. `dvb destroy aegis` removes the box, so use sleep when you only want to pause it.

input.description: Confirm when boxes consume box-hours

content.text:
Yes. While **aegis** is running, it uses box-hours. At its size, 4 vCPU / 8 GB, one awake hour costs **1 box-hour**.

Sleeping stops that. `dvb sleep aegis` pauses the box, and a sleeping box does not use box-hours. Waking it starts usage again.

Those hours come from your plan’s included amount first (20 on a trial, 50 on Starter, 300 on Pro, or 750 on Max). Prepaid credits are used only after the included hours run out, at $0.40 per extra box-hour.

content.text:
Yes. Run **omp** in the box terminal. It does not replace the boxes.dev threads, which stay Codex or Claude.

Wake the box, open **Terminal** in the Mac app, and install it there:

```bash
dvb wake aegis
```

```bash
curl -fsSL https://omp.sh/install | sh
cd ~/aegis
omp
```

Set a model API key in that terminal before you launch it. Browser sign-in is unreliable on the headless box. An install on the Template box is available to new devboxes only after you save a snapshot. An install inside one devbox stays on that devbox.
